table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	srinvcode = dbo.srledger.srinvcode, 
	date = dbo.srledger.date, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc, 
	flatdisc = dbo.srledger.flatdisc, 
	misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
	invgstperc1 = dbo.srledger.invgstperc1, 
	invsalestax = dbo.srledger.salestax,
	remarks = dbo.srledger.remarks,
	custcode = dbo.srledger.custcode,
	looseqty = dbo.srdetail.looseqty, 
	bonusqty = dbo.srdetail.bonusqty,
	packqty  = srdetail.packqty, 
	packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end,
	price = dbo.srdetail.srprice, 
	itemdiscperc = dbo.srdetail.discperc, 
	packunits = dbo.srdetail.packunits, 
	unitsalestax = dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax, 
	gstperc = dbo.srdetail.gstperc, 
	batch = dbo.srdetail.batch, 
	expiry = dbo.srdetail.expiry, 
	salestax  = srdetail.salestax,
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, srledger.date)))), 
	aliasname = dbo.accounts.aliasname, 
	Person = dbo.accounts.name,
	doctype = Case dbo.srledger.srcatcode When 6 Then 'Cash' When 7 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End,
	NTN = customer.ntnno,
	SalesTaxRegNo = customer.SalesTaxRegNo,
	rowid=dbo.srdetail.rowid,
	invtotal = srledger.invtotal
FROM
	dbo.srledger, 
	dbo.srdetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.customer
WHERE  
	dbo.srledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and 
	dbo.srledger.custcode IN (:al_CustCode) and 
	dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (6,7,8) and
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
	dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and
	dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode and 
	dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
table.sort: person A, srinvcode A, rowid A

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum( invtotal for all distinct srinvcode)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round((  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  , 2) + ((looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax ) + Round( looseqty * price * (1 -  itemdiscperc *.01) *  gstperc * .01, 2)

objects.name: c_salestax
objects.expression: ((looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax ) + Round( looseqty * price * (1 -  itemdiscperc *.01) *  gstperc * .01, 2)

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: sum( invtotal for group 1 distinct srinvcode)

objects.name: c_invdiscount
objects.expression: Sum (( (  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) for group 2 )  *  ( Sum(invdiscperc for group 2 distinct srinvcode) * .01)

objects.name: c_invsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Round ( ( Sum( ( looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  - flatdisc  ) , 2 ) * ( invgstperc1 * 0.01 ),  2)

objects.name: c_invtotsalestax
objects.expression: Round(Sum((looseqty + bonusqty) * unitsalestax for group 2) + Sum(Round( looseqty * price * (1 -  itemdiscperc *.01) *  gstperc * .01, 2) for group 2) + Round ( Round ( ( Sum( ( looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  - flatdisc  ) , 2 ) * ( invgstperc1 * 0.01 ),  2), 0)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round((Sum( (looseqty * price * (1- itemdiscperc * .01 )) - ( salestax * looseqty) for group 2) *  (1- invdiscperc * .01 )) -  flatdisc + misccharges, 0) + c_invtotsalestax
